saveFailure.cause: Official generated Windows batch wrapper uses CRLF. The repository's Git whitespace settings treat each CR as trailing whitespace. The Python pre-save whitespace scan used splitlines(), which hid CRs and therefore missed this. Neither wrapper line endings nor whitespace settings were altered after the failed save. The driver must stop and preserve this workspace, not accept the earlier progress-shaped staged report.
